full_prompt_en: A square painterly city view centers on a monumental mosque crowned by a dark green dome and surrounded by slender pointed minarets. The upper background is blue sky filled with large cream clouds whose softly lit edges rise behind the central roof. Distant pale towers and smaller domes appear through atmospheric haze on both sides, suggesting a dense city beyond the main square. The great dome occupies the upper middle, resting on a broad round base with small windows and a warm stone cornice. In front of it, a smaller green cupola and a deep arched opening step down toward the entrance. Tall minarets stand to either side, their pale shafts broken by narrow balconies and capped with dark green spires; an additional partial tower frames the far left edge. At ground level, a wide stone plaza leads straight to the dark central doors. Tiny figures scatter across the sunlit paving, giving scale to the massive facade without dominating it. Lower buildings and small green domes line the approach on both sides, creating a funnel toward the center. The stonework is rendered in ochre, sand, and warm gray, with darker outlines and uneven brushy texture that soften the many architectural details. The view is frontal but slightly elevated over the square, allowing the route and clustered rooftops to remain visible. Sunlight from the upper left brightens cloud edges, dome highlights, minaret shafts, and portions of the plaza; cool brown-gray shadows deepen arches and side streets. The painterly edges are clear enough to read the tiers of domes and towers but remain atmospheric in the far city. The composition gathers the crowded urban foreground into one dominant central silhouette, balancing warm stone with green roofs and an expansive luminous sky.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形绘画式城市景观以一座宏伟清真寺为中心，深绿色大穹顶周围耸立纤细尖塔。上方背景是蓝天与大片奶油色云朵，柔和受光的云缘在中央屋顶后升起。两侧远处的浅色塔楼和较小圆顶透过空气薄雾显现，暗示主广场外还有密集城区。巨大的穹顶占据上方中部，坐落在带小窗与暖色石檐的宽阔圆形基座上。其前方，一个较小绿顶与一道深拱形开口逐级下降到入口。高耸的尖塔列在两侧，浅色塔身被狭窄阳台分段，并戴着深绿尖顶；最左边缘还有一座局部入画的塔。地面上，宽阔石铺广场直通深色中央大门。阳光下的铺地上散落着微小人物，为巨大的立面提供尺度，却没有主导画面。较低的房屋和小绿顶沿引道两侧排列，形成指向中央的漏斗。石砌以赭色、沙色和暖灰色描绘，较深的轮廓和不均匀的笔触肌理柔化繁多的细部。视点近于正面，却比广场稍高，使道路与拥挤屋顶仍然可见。左上方阳光照亮云缘、穹顶高光、尖塔塔身及广场部分区域；冷棕灰色阴影加深拱券和侧街。绘画边缘足以看清层叠圆顶与塔楼，而远方城区仍带空气感。构图把拥挤的城市前景汇入一个占主导的中央剪影，在暖石色、绿屋顶与广阔明亮天空之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: A painterly panoramic treatment arranges warm sand and ochre masses in a deep central perspective beneath a spacious blue upper field. Dark green rounded crowns and narrow vertical spires punctuate the broad pale forms, creating a clear rhythm of large and fine shapes. Visible soft brush grain and slightly broken outlines keep intricate detail atmospheric, while crisp dark openings establish structural depth. Light from the upper left gives cloudlike upper forms bright cream edges and turns outward surfaces golden; cooler brown-gray shade gathers in recesses and along the lower side passages. A busy low band of small marks leads toward one dominant middle silhouette, with distant forms losing contrast gradually. The image feels grand, sunlit, and gently weathered rather than polished or diagrammatic.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式全景表现把暖沙色与赭色体块排成深远的中央透视，上方留有宽阔蓝色色域。深绿色圆形顶部与狭长竖向尖形点缀宽阔浅色形体，形成大形与细形的明确节奏。可见的柔和笔触颗粒与略断续轮廓让繁密细节保有空气感，清楚的深色开口则建立结构纵深。左上方光线给云朵般的高处形态勾出明亮奶油色边缘，并把朝外表面染成金色；较冷的棕灰阴影聚在凹处和下方侧向通道里。由细小痕迹组成的繁忙下带把视线引向占主导的中间剪影，远处形体逐渐失去反差。画面宏大、阳光充足、略显风化，而非光洁或图解式。
theme_en: A great green-domed mosque above a sunlit city square
theme_zh: 阳光城市广场上的宏大绿顶清真寺
name: Ottoman architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
